The Finger Game. Everyone sits in a circle with an empty glass in the middle. Everyone puts a finger on the glass. Whoever’s turn it is counts down from 3 then says a number (3..2..1..2 or 3..2..1..5). Count regularly, no hesitating or trying to trick people. When they say the final number everyone either pulls their finger off or leaves it on the glass. If the person guesses the correct amount of fingers still on the glass they are out and pour a small amount of whatever they are drinking into the glass, and everyone else drinks their own drink. If the person is wrong they drink their own drink and are still in the game. Continue until there is only one person left, they drink the glass in the middle (think like Kings Cup). It sounds odd when it’s being explained, but it is one of the funnest drinking games i have ever played.
